messages:
emma_sales: FYI Pulse Analytics coming up for renewal next month, want to move from hosted to Dedicated and asking for a rebaseline + uplift discount. Their CSM flagged performance spikes during peak hours.
emma_sales: Short summary: current ARR $185k, current committed spend $55k/yr, avg tokens/month ~2.4B, peak concurrency causing latency > 800ms on p95. They want a 12-month commit for Dedicated GPU pool.
sara_cs: They asked for EU data residency and SOC2 evidence. Also want a 2-week POC to validate throughput and KV cache behavior.
emma_sales: Deal ask: 12mo commit, target blended effective rate $0.0105/token (vs list $0.0145) to get them to sign. Also want free POC (2 weeks) with support from runtime eng.
luis_dealdesk: Can you drop ARR and current gross margin impact? 30% off list is big. Need attach math + justification for strategic customer/expansion.
emma_sales: ARR if closed roughly +$280k new ARR (upgrade + renewal). Margin hit est ~ -12% on unit token revenue at proposed rate assuming current infra cost. I can draft a short business case.
dan_engineering: For POC we need details: model family (they use open-gpt-3-like), max seq len 2048, target throughput 1.2M tokens/min sustained, KV cache reuse ~40%. Do we have a compatible Dedicated profile?
kevin_legal: Also need to review special terms: data residency, audit rights, and indemnity carveouts. If they want on-prem connector or private control plane we should price that separately.
luis_dealdesk: Upload the usage CSV + top 3 monthly peaks and the proposed pricing calc. Without that we can't approve >20% discount.
emma_sales: Uploading sample usage now. CSV link: https://redwood.internal/pulse/usage-sample (internal).
deploy-bot: New doc created: /sales/pulse/renewal/2001800000-usage-sample.csv by emma_sales
dan_engineering: For the POC we can allocate a small Dedicated pool for 2 weeks. Need to confirm GPU type (A10G vs A100) — A10G might be fine with quantized model, but if they need lower latency we should propose A100 + 2x vCPU headroom.
sara_cs: Timeline constraint: customer wants Go-live within 6 weeks of signing. POC must be completed in week 1-2, migration in week 3-6.
luis_dealdesk: Preliminary decision: approve 20% discount off list for 12mo commit if sales gets exec sign-off and covers POC costs (we charge setup fee $8k). Anything beyond needs director sign-off.
kevin_legal: I'll start on the amendments for data residency and SOC2 attestation. If they request on-prem or HSM, that'll be a separate SOW.
emma_sales: Noted. Proposed price to present to customer: 12mo commit, blended $0.0116/token, setup $8k, 2-week POC included but limited to performance validation (no custom engineering work).
luis_dealdesk: Please include the 12mo T&Cs and commit ramp schedule in the quoting sheet. Send to me and cc kevin_legal.
emma_sales: Will do. Draft quote ETA 24h.
dan_engineering: I'll reserve a test pool and send the POC runbook. Need contact for their infra: @pulse-devops.
sara_cs: I'll coordinate migration checklist and CS playbook.
kevin_legal: If they push for rollback SLAs or special indemnities, escalate to me before counter-signing.
emma_sales: Thanks team — leaning to accept 20% discount + $8k setup to keep them. I'll post quote once luis confirms.
luis_dealdesk: Confirmed conditional approval. Approver: luis_dealdesk. Condition: usage CSV + exec sign-off + setup fee charged.
emma_sales: Got it, will close loop. <3"
